description: A Perl script implementing a Git filter protocol version 2, acting as a minimal pass-through filter handling packet communication between Git and external filters. It reads and writes packets over standard input/output and manages filter commands like 'clean' and 'smudge'.

methods.name: packet_bin_read
methods.description: Reads a binary packet from STDIN, interprets the size header, and returns the status and content.

methods.name: packet_txt_read
methods.description: Reads a text packet from STDIN, expecting LF termination, and returns the status and line.

methods.name: packet_bin_write
methods.description: Writes a binary packet to STDOUT with the length-prefixed header.

methods.name: packet_txt_write
methods.description: Writes a text packet to STDOUT, appending LF.

methods.name: packet_flush
methods.description: Flushes the packet stream by sending a zero-length packet.
